fullPassage: One day, my father took me and my brother on a camping trip. While driving to a nearby forest, he explained how to set up the tent. Almost immediately after we arrived, however, my brother was stung by a wasp, which caused his forehead to swell. We tried to catch our dinner by fishing in a nearby lake, but we failed miserably, returning with nothing but dozens of mosquito bites. Without any fish, we cooked a can of beans over a campfire, which was an unwise endeavor that burned the bottom layer of beans while leaving those on top cold. When bedtime came, we unrolled my father's old sleeping bags to find them stinking of damp mold. The odor was so overpowering that even my father gave up. We packed the tent, got in the car, and drove home.

② fish: 'by fish in a nearby lake'? 전치사 by 뒤에는 명사/동명사가 와야 하므로 동명사 fishing(낚시하는 것)이 맞음 ←정답
③ cooked: 'we cooked a can' 과거시제 — 적절
④ drove: 'and drove home' 과거시제 — 적절
det.tip: by + 동명사(-ing) = ~함으로써. by fish(X) → by fishing(O)

det.korean: swell → to swell (cause + 목적어 + to부정사: A가 ~하게 하다)
det.analysis:
① swell: 'which caused his forehead swell'? 동사 cause는 '목적어 + to부정사'를 취하므로(cause A to do: A가 ~하게 하다) to swell로 써야 함 ←정답
② leaving: 'burned the bottom layer of beans while leaving those on top cold'? while이 이끄는 분사구문의 현재분사 leaving — 적절
③ stinking: 'to find them stinking of damp mold'? find + 목적어 + 현재분사(~가 …하고 있는 것을 발견하다) 구조 — 적절
④ drove: 'packed the tent, got in the car, and drove home'에서 세 동사가 과거시제로 병렬 연결 — 적절
det.tip: cause + 목적어 + to부정사 = ~가 …하게 하다. caused his forehead swell(X) → to swell(O)
